findings.evidence: "**Mindfulness (5-10 min/day):**" — long stretches of the reference are generic wellness advice (mindfulness minutes, sleep hygiene, therapy recommendations) the model knows and the agent should not recite
findings.fix: Prune the file to the regulation worksheet, trigger inventory, and workplace day-of preparation

findings.evidence: "# Difficult Conversation Framework" — the file largely restates classic communication-training material (facts-vs-story tables, three-phase structure, listening techniques) the model already produces
findings.fix: Cut the textbook explanation and keep the expert deltas: time/place rules, agreement and email templates, success measures

findings.evidence: "Default opening for direct feedback: **situation → observable behavior → impact → open question**" — the compensation/scope negotiation route has no compact default opening in SKILL.md
findings.fix: Add a negotiation default: purpose + evidence + specific ask + openness to alternatives

findings.evidence: "Never promise absolute confidentiality; explain that some concerns may need escalation." — the NEVER list omits the discoverability gotcha for written records
findings.fix: Add: assume any written summary may be reviewed in a formal HR/legal process; keep records factual and shared only need-to-know

findings.evidence: "allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep" — comma-separated, but the specification defines allowed-tools as a space-separated string, so strict parsers read tool names with trailing commas
"[feedback-mastery](../feedback-mastery/SKILL.md)" — the reference escapes the skill root instead of staying skill-root-relative and one level deep
findings.fix: Reference the sibling skill by name ('route to the feedback-mastery skill') rather than a file path

findings.evidence: "For a full facilitated multi-party plan, load [conversation-framework.md]" — the trigger undersells a file that is the general three-phase guide, so it will not load for deep one-on-one prep where it applies
findings.fix: Reword the trigger to 'for full three-phase preparation or a facilitated multi-party plan'

findings.evidence: "Adapt tone to relationship and stakes; invite correction of facts." — no default register for power-imbalanced conversations
findings.fix: Default to formal-neutral, short sentences with senior stakeholders unless the user signals otherwise

findings.evidence: "**Adequate sleep:**" — the reference is written as advice to the human reader with no instruction for how the agent should use it, inviting unsolicited lifestyle coaching
findings.fix: Add a usage note at the top: offer at most one in-the-moment technique when the user asks; never lecture on sleep or therapy
